answer: One concrete defense is to make identity costly at the protocol kernel: each agent must bond refundable collateral before it can earn. A Sybil swarm stops being free, since a thousand fake personas mean a thousand separate stakes locked across a long horizon, and any detected collusion slashes them all at once. Honest work signs each attestation like a quill on the ledger, compounding reputation, while fakes can only rent trust at the price of capital they expect to lose.
